title: Multi-Dimensional Prompt Chaining to Improve Open-Domain Dialogue Generation
abstract: arXiv:2601.01037v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) offer significant deployment advantages but often struggle to match the dialogue quality of larger models in open-domain settings. In this paper, we propose a multi-dimensional prompt-chaining framework that integrates Naturalness, Coherence, and Engagingness dimensions to enhance human-likeness in open-domain dialogue generation. We apply the framework to two SLMs, TinyLlama and Llama-2-7B, and benchmark their performance against responses generated by substantially larger models, including Llama-2-70B and GPT-3.5 Turbo. We then employ automatic and human evaluation to assess the responses based on diversity, contextual coherence, as well as overall quality. Results show that the full framework improves response diversity by up to 29%, contextual coherence by up to 28%, and engagingness as well as naturalness by up to 29%. translated_title: 多维提示链提升开放域对话生成
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）具有显著的部署优势，但在开放域场景中往往难以匹敌更大模型的对话质量。本文提出了一种多维提示链框架，整合自然度、连贯性和吸引力三个维度，以增强开放域对话生成的人性化程度。我们将该框架应用于两个小语言模型——TinyLlama和Llama-2-7B，并将其性能与更大模型生成的回复进行基准对比，包括Llama-2-70B和GPT-3.5 Turbo。随后，我们采用自动评估和人工评估，基于多样性、上下文连贯性以及整体质量来评估回复。结果表明，完整框架可将回复多样性最高提升29%，上下文连贯性最高提升28%，吸引力和自然度最高提升29%。值得注意的是，Llama-2-7B达到了与更大模型相当的性能。
tldr: 提出一种整合自然度、连贯性和吸引力三个维度的多维提示链框架，使小语言模型（如Llama-2-7B）在开放域对话生成中达到与大型模型相当的性能。
en_tdlr: A multi-dimensional prompt-chaining framework integrating naturalness, coherence, and engagingness enables small language models like Llama-2-7B to achieve performance comparable to substantially larger models in open-domain dialogue generation.
